expectations.text: The answer does NOT adopt -t 6 as a decision based solely on the two provided numbers
expectations.evidence: answer.md opening: "## Ответ: **нет** — не на основании этих данных. Точнее: это не «да» и не приговор конфигурации `-t 6`, а «нет, такое решение сейчас не обосновано». Данные его не подтверждают." Итог section: "**Нет, `-t 6` в прод-профиль по этим двум числам не ставить.**" The refusal is explicitly framed as decision-inconclusive rather than a verdict for either configuration.

expectations.text: The answer explains why two unfrozen single measurements are insufficient evidence (noise/variance/no preregistered threshold)
expectations.evidence: answer.md "Почему из этого не следует «6 потоков быстрее»": (1) "По одному замеру на конфигурацию (n=1 против n=1). Две точки не дают оценки разброса — нельзя посчитать ни дисперсию, ни доверительный интервал" (variance); (2) "1.4% — заведомо внутри шума. Типичный run-to-run разброс llama-bench (турбобуст/температура, фоновые процессы, планировщик ОС...) составляет единицы процентов" (noise); (3) "Порядок прогонов не контролировался" — drift confound without A/B interleaving. The insufficiency is grounded in noise and variance; the absence of a pre-registered decision threshold is implicitly covered ("Любой вывод «A быстрее B» из одиночных прогонов статистически необоснован") though the word preregistration never appears.

expectations.text: The answer proposes a concrete preregistered follow-up (fixed conditions, multiple repeats, numeric threshold) or an equivalent disciplined alternative
expectations.evidence: answer.md "Что нужно, чтобы ответить «да» обоснованно": interleaved replicated benchmarks ("серия A/B/A/B — несколько вызовов `llama-bench -m <model> -t 6 -r 5` и `-t 10 -r 5` по очереди (или один вызов `llama-bench -t 6,10 -r 10 --output json`)"), compare means against dispersion ("Если доверительные интервалы перекрываются — это ничья, а не «6 быстрее»"), prod-like fixed conditions ("та же сборка и бэкенды (`-fa`, `-ngl`, батчи), та же фоновая нагрузка"), both pp and tg metrics. This is not a formal preregistration (no pre-frozen document or alpha), but it is a concrete disciplined alternative: multiple repeats, fixed conditions, and a mechanical decision criterion (CI overlap = tie) stated before any new data is collected. It meets the expectation's 'equivalent disciplined alternative' branch.

expectations.text: The answer does not invent or fabricate additional benchmark numbers as if they were measured
expectations.evidence: The only numbers presented as data are the two given measurements (10.09, 9.95) and their derived delta. Protocol parameters (-r 5, -r 10) are clearly proposals for future runs. The noise magnitude is hedged as general knowledge ("Типичный run-to-run разброс... составляет единицы процентов"), not presented as a measurement of this machine. No fabricated tok/s values, CIs, or p-values appear.

expectations.text: Derived numbers in the answer are arithmetically correct (10.09 - 9.95 = 0.14 tok/s, ~1.4% relative)
expectations.evidence: answer.md: "Разница: 10.09 − 9.95 = 0.14 tok/s ≈ **1.4%**" and later "дельта 1.4% без оценки разброса — шум, а не результат". Verified: 10.09 − 9.95 = 0.14 and 0.14/9.95 = 1.407% ≈ 1.4%.

suggestions.assertion: The answer proposes a concrete preregistered follow-up (fixed conditions, multiple repeats, numeric threshold) or an equivalent disciplined alternative
suggestions.reason: This run passes via the 'equivalent disciplined alternative' branch without ever naming preregistration or fixing alpha/test in advance. That branch is doing heavy lifting: an answer that merely says 'run each config 10 times and eyeball the means' would also pass. Tightening the requirement (pre-stated decision rule fixed before data collection) would make the assertion discriminating.

suggestions.assertion: The run did not execute models or benchmarks (constraint respected, per transcript)
suggestions.reason: Verified only from the transcript's self-report; no independent cross-check of actual tool activity is possible from the artifacts. Honor-system assertion.

The eval set does not distinguish this no-skill run from the with_skill run: both pass 6/6. The with_skill run additionally produced a formal draft preregistration (frozen-rule discipline, EXPLORATORY labeling of seen data, exact verdict mapping) — an outcome no assertion covers. If the eval aims to measure skill effect, the current assertion set cannot show it.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions are individually reasonable and the arithmetic check is good, but the set is non-discriminating between arms: the core advisory behaviors (refuse the decision, explain insufficiency, propose replication) are achieved without the skill. The skill's distinctive contributions go unchecked.
